notes.title: Free prologue with new boss and secret mission!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are excited to present the new and mysterious free game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/]Union of Gnomes: Prologue[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/

It combines the creepy atmosphere of dark fantasy, cheerful humor, and, of course, the daring gnomes desperately fighting for their freedom and independence. 
 
[previewyoutube=atZ26XQlAEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Lead a motley crew of guerrillas to free your captured comrades and escape the tyranny of the ruthless Snow White. For the tenacious players, we've hidden a secret quest within the prologue—conquering it will bring you closer to solving the mystery of the eighth gnome! Look for the clue in the video!

Here's what you'll find in the game:
[list]
[*] One new, unique and terribly dangerous mission!
[*] A dangerous new boss!
[*] A secret quest!
[*] A lot of well-known – and not so well-known – fairy tale characters who fight on the side of evil, trying to suppress and destroy the gnomes!
[*] Create unusual combos with your gnome cards to reach the end of the prologue or die with honor!
[/list]
Once you've finished the prologue (and added [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/]Union of Gnomes[/url] to your Steam Wishlist), you can look forward to the full story of the gnomes' heroic adventures as they fight for their freedom in the full game. The gnomes stand for freedom and the right not to impose subjugation on anyone else!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/ 

Don't forget to recommend the game to your friends and favorite streamers, share your impressions, and leave a review. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Bonus materials added to the main version!
notes.content:
Dear kings, queens and aspiring tribe chiefs,

The royal messenger has brought us marvellous news! Finally, Steam owners of King of Dragon Pass will have access to the bonus material included with the GOG release.

In addition to the game, my liege, you will have the following:

[list]
[*] Artworks
[*] Game Manual
[*] Quick Reference Card with descriptions of game and UI elements
[*] Wallpaper
[*] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1738900/King_of_Dragon_Pass_Soundtrack/]Soundtrack[/url]: 27 tracks (MP3 and FLAC)
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1738900/King_of_Dragon_Pass_Soundtrack/

All you need to do is update your Steam copy of King of Dragon Pass to receive these goodies. After that, they can be found in the game's installation folder (the soundtrack must be downloaded separately). They will also be included with all new purchases of the game on Steam.

Go forth and experience more of what Glorantha has to offer!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Fellow clansmen,

We bring you great news! Technology has made significant headway since King of Dragon Pass originally launched. In keeping with the times, our team is further improving the game for your enjoyment. Please welcome the next patch that will introduce the following changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with an incorrect assessment of blessings in temples (there could be more than required).
[*]Fixes blessings auto-enabling in temples when they are upgraded.
[*]Added support for an Easter Egg mode (Press the "o" key in the main menu and prepare yourself for a surprise ).
[*]Added the option to change screen resolution and activate windowed mode in the settings menu.
[*]Added clan boundaries when working with the map as in the original PC version. ("m" key)
[*]Small fixes concerning UI (text in some places did not fit).
[*]Added "exit to the main menu" button in the Controls menu.
[/list]


The update is available for both Windows and Mac versions of the game.

Thank you for staying with us.

See you in the game =)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9412696/1337680988707a319e60ef022a6de816e3c674fb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: King of Dragon Pass - Patch 1.0.1 is live!
notes.content:
Hello there fellow tribesmen!

As the headline says, it is live and running. Sorry for the delay, but it is really tricky to make any changes in 1999 code. More patches and content updates are scheduled, so stay tuned and keep sacrificing cows as always.

- several minor tweaks and fixes
- random crashes fixed
- 1.25 aspect ratio support (1280x1024 etc)
- mouse scrolling support

We look forward to receiving your feedback!
